name: Son La food guide
summary: Son La eats a Thái hearth and a Hmong pot: pa pỉnh tộp, hearth-smoked buffalo, cơm lam, xôi ngũ sắc, nậm pịa, and rượu cần. The fish is not stuffed one way. The buffalo is not smoked on one clock. Mộc Châu yogurt, hau plum, and tea stay on the plateau.
body: Start with the fish and the buffalo. Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La splits a stream fish along the back, stuffs it with ginger, lemongrass, and mắc khén, and sends it to the table with xôi nếp. Vietnam.vn, on 2 April 2024, stuffs carp, trôi, or trắm with herbs, hạt dổi, and sa nhân shoots, then rubs the outside with galangal powder and toasted rice powder. Báo Sơn La, on 4 September 2020, keeps the organs, removes the gall, and allows rô phi. Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, adds mương and calls the taste hot, sour, and sweet. All four lists stay.

The buffalo is the plate that keeps, and the smoke is not one clock. The museum handbook leaves it black outside and red inside, with forest chili, pepper, and mắc khén. Báo Sơn La, on 2 July 2021, dries it over the fire for a few days, then steams it and dries it again. The same paper, on 15 May 2025, quotes a Chiềng Cơi workshop: marinate 1–2 hours, then smoke about 6–8 hours to a dark brown. Eat it at Bản Mòng or carry it.

Cơm lam, nậm pịa, xôi ngũ sắc, măng bói, and the jar sit on the same table. Chợ Trung tâm is the morning hall on the old Chiềng Lề street, now inside phường Tô Hiệu. Chợ 7-11 is the other daily hall, in phường Quyết Thắng. The Saturday stalls on Hoàng Quốc Việt run only from 19:30 to 23:00 on the two walking-street nights. Mộc Châu yogurt, hau plum, tea, and the snails at Suối Bàng stay on the plateau.
specialtiesLead: The smoked buffalo is the plate to know first. The other specialties are the ones Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La, Báo Sơn La, Vietnam.vn, and Vietnamnet name.

sections.heading: Son La specialties
paragraphs: Forty-two more specialties follow the buffalo. Báo Sơn La, on 16 July 2026, lists about 120,000–150,000 VND for minced meat in a leaf at a Chiềng Cơi kitchen, and about 30,000–60,000 VND for a 200 g box of dry chẩm chéo.

sections.heading: Markets
paragraphs: Two daily halls and one Saturday street. These are markets, not specialties. The Saturday stalls exist only when the walking street is on.

spots.name: Central market

spots.note: Sở Công Thương, on the list updated 10 July 2024, puts the hall at 8,940 m², hạng 2, solid, meeting daily.

spots.name: Cho 7-11
spots.note: The other hạng 2 daily market, 6,615 m² on the same 2024 list.

spots.name: Saturday stalls
spots.nameVi: Phố đi bộ Hoàng Quốc Việt

spots.note: Food stalls only on the walking-street nights, 19:30–23:00, two Saturdays a month, in Báo Sơn La on 28 May 2025. Other nights the street is an ordinary road.

seoTitle: Son La food — Thai hearth, not the plateau yogurt
seoDescription: Pa pỉnh tộp, smoked buffalo, bamboo-tube rice, five-color sticky rice, and jar wine in Sơn La. Stuffings and smoke times disagree.
